title: Mapsha’ah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Nedarim 10b reads, “Mapsha’ah taught.” Rashi and the Rosh explain that this is a sage’s name. Hyman reports that the Rosh’s commentary reads “Rav Yosef Mapsha’ah taught.” He calls this a scribal error and says the words came from the preceding line, “Rav Yosef taught.”

notes.text: The longer Rosh reading adds Rav Yosef before Mapsha’ah. No geographical “of Mapsha’ah” is present in the supplied Hebrew. The explanation that the words came from the preceding line is Hyman’s.
The consulted digital Rosh calls Mapsha’ah a sage and mentions Rav Yosef in the preceding separate comment. Hyman reports the longer wording and attributes it to copying from the preceding line.
